name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You've been coming here every day. Are you still looking for that ghost?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we don't even have a lead yet."

name: Shiori
message: "Which brings us here again today, to hear about another urban legend."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, and it doesn't have to be related to children. Anything you want us to look into is fine."

name: Shiori
message: "We might find an unexpected lead, and there's our deal to consider too."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...If you say so."

name: Shiori
message: "Yup, please let us hear it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Have you heard about 'meikon'? 'Mei' as in underworld, and 'kon' as in marriage. In short, ghost marriage."

name: Shiori
message: "You mean marrying the dead? Yes, I've heard about it."

name: Shiori
message: "Something like, if you pick up a red envelope, you're forced to marry the deceased? That kind of thing?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There's a place nearby where that red envelope supposedly turns up."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? But red envelopes aren't even a thing here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That's just how urban legends are. If enough people believe in them, they come true, regardless of the contradictions."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That custom was already considered dubious, even in the place where it originated from."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "A man who picks up an envelope is forced to marry a woman who died unmarried."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I mean, think about it. Who leaves their daughter's marriage to chance? A creep could pick it up."

name: Shiori
message: "When you put it that way, I guess it makes sense."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Urban legends don't have to be true. If anything, the wilder the lie, the faster the rumor spreads."

name: Shiori
message: "So as talk of ghost marriage spread, the urban legend took root in this town... is that it?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "More accurately, it *may* have taken root. To be honest, I find it a little suspicious."

name: Shiori
message: "So we just need to check if the red envelope actually exists."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Exactly."

name: Shiori
message: "So, where is it?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Show me your map."
(Launch the Maps app)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I think it was..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Around here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There aren't any specific steps to make the red envelope appear. It's just pure luck. It should be lying somewhere noticeable."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, got it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you find it, I'd appreciate it if you brought it back, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "It forces you to marry a female ghost, right? Then it should be fine if a woman picks it up."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I don't know the exact form this urban legend has taken. It might even activate as long as a living person picks it up."

name: Shiori
message: "In that case, I wonder if it'd be fine if I picked it up."

name: Shiori
message: "...No, wait. If same sex marriage counts, then it's a completely different story."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Meikon means marriage between the living and the dead. It shouldn't apply if it's between two dead people."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But we'll never know what might happen, so just check whether the red envelope actually exists and report back."

name: Shiori
message: "Got it. If it feels dangerous, I won't touch it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Good. And... there's one more urban legend, one that might involve children."

name: Shiori
message: "Might?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It depends on the variant. In the more prominent version, no children appear. But in the lesser one, they do."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm sure you already know all about the well-known version. It's Mary-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, that one's really famous. Mary-san the doll, right?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yeah. The lesser—or rather, local version? Anyway, around these parts, it's a little girl, not a doll."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Good. And... there's one more urban legend, a very famous one. It's Mary-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, that one's really famous. Mary-san the doll, right?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yes. But what's prevalent around here is the local version, where she's not a doll, but a little girl instead."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There are other variants too. You know that payphone around five minutes away from here?"

name: Shiori
message: "I think so... It stands out, since you don't see them a lot anymore."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You pick up the phone, but don't dial anything. You then say this:"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "'Mary-san, Mary-san, let's play, Mary-san.'"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "After that, hang up and wait until the phone rings. It's going to be from Mary-san."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "She'll tell you she'll be right there."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then if you wait a little longer, this time *your* phone rings."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "She'll say she's right behind you."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm? Isn't Mary-san supposed to slowly walk up to you from behind?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Kids these days want instant payoff."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess we've reached the point where even ghost stories get skimmed on 2x speed..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...It completely ruins the creeping dread, which is the whole point. Still, it's better than the story being forgotten entirely, at least."

name: Shiori
message: "Once she says she's right behind you, she kills you, right?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That part is vague even in the original. The common interpretation is that you're killed, though."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "In the local version, it's fifty-fifty. Sometimes she kills you, sometimes she just plays with you. A mix of sweetness and brutality."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I wouldn't recommend it, given there's a chance you'll get killed... but if you really want to meet the girl's ghost, you could take the gamble."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'd call it reckless and suicidal, though."

name: Shiori
message: "Suicidal... huh."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Don't tell me..."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Did you try spiriting yourselves away?"
"Yes."
"No."
"Yesn't."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You're kidding..."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry... our curiosity got the better of us..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Hey, no lying."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. Our curiosity got the better of us, and we ended up trying it..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Which is it?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry... we tried it out..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You're kidding..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's true..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Since you're still here in one piece, I take it you didn't get spirited away?"

name: Shiori
message: "Actually..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "My buddy here got sent to the mirror world."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "How did you even make it back...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Apparently, a mysterious dog appeared and showed the way to the exit."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "A dog...? I've never heard of that variation... A truth about an urban legend unveiled..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You have my thanks. My knowledge of that urban legend has deepened."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Uh... okay? You're... welcome?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you don't mind risking your life, you should try meeting Mary-san as well."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm... I... guess? Though personally, I'd rather avoid anything dangerous from now on..."

name: Shiori
message: "Reckless, huh... Yeah, I don't think it's something people should try on a whim, given the risks."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I wasn't sure if I should tell you, since it might get you killed..."

name: Shiori
message: "But a rumor that big is bound to make you curious, right?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Exactly. It's been on my mind for a while."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But as I said earlier... the decision is yours. I won't force you into anything."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. I'll admit, the part about the little ghost girl does catch my interest... but if it's dangerous, we'll have to think it over."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There are still more urban legends out there, but that's it for today."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Whether you confront the aberrations is entirely up to you."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. We'll report back if we find anything."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I've spoken too much. You should go now."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you for the information. See you again."

name: Shiori
message: "The ghost marriage and Mary-san. Both sound dangerous."

name: Shiori
message: "They don't seem related to the case, but I'm still a little curious. I really did seem to love stories like these."

name: Shiori
message: "If you're interested too, we should check them out."

name: Shiori
message: "But don't try anything too dangerous, okay?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You're here again."
(Ask about the ghost marriage)
(Ask about Mary-san)
(Ask about Kashima Reiko)
(Leave)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's more than just an urban legend or a rumor. The custom itself actually exists. Some regions in Japan even practiced it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It appears in myths too, so it may have existed in various parts of the world long ago."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The red envelope version, though, is a relatively recent urban legend rooted in the internet."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "When an unmarried woman dies, her family places a red envelope by the roadside. If someone picks it up, the family, who had been watching, appears and forces them to marry the deceased."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But in reality, traditions describe using divination to ask the deceased for approval. If the deceased rejects the candidate, the family simply places the envelope again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Urban legends tend to skip all the complicated parts. So in this one, you just pick it up, and that's it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They say the envelope contains the deceased's photo, a lock of their hair, and money."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Anyway, you should keep in mind that it's *just* an urban legend."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There are claims that the story is heavily exaggerated, or that it only started recently, or never existed in the first place."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The practice of ghost marriage does exist, but the story this urban legend was based on is... questionable at best."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So take care not to embarrass yourself by talking about it like a know-it-all."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They say Mary-san originated in the 70s."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That was during the first occult boom. She then resurfaced during the second occult boom in the 90s."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Given that the urban legend's been passed down all the way to the present, there are countless variations now."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There were a lot of supposed countermeasures too... but there were too many that none took root. Which likely means they don't work."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "However... she's been turning into a toy in recent years."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Or rather... moe-fied?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "For example, versions where she fails to scare or kill someone and ends up crying instead are becoming more and more common."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "At this rate, Mary-san's urban legend might end up turning into some kind of comedy skit."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "She might even approach you amicably. But don't let your guard down. The chance of her trying to kill you is very real."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Me...? There's nothing for me to say."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I am merely a sinner bound to this place... a tainted soul who has committed every sin, and curses all the living."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Nothing less, nothing more."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You'd best watch your back. Aberrations do not know mercy. They'll reap your souls without a second thought."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You're back, I see. How fares the search?"
(Ask about Mary-san)
(Ask about Kashima Reiko)
(Leave)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Best of luck now... Give it all you've got."
(Ask about the ghost marriage)
(Ask about Kashima Reiko)
(Leave)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Farewell. I'll be here, waiting for your next report."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...? You're back. Was there anything else?"
(Ask about Kashima Reiko)
(Leave)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm just an urban legend fanatic."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ever since I was little, I could see things no one should be able to see... Apparitions were an ever-present existence to me."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm not sure why, but this town has an unusually high rate of supernatural incidents."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "After moving here, I chased after countless urban legends, countless apparitions."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then my wish came true, so here I am now."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "At the end of that wish lay my death."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So I don't need your sympathy. It'll be no different from an insult."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm here of my own will."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Are you satisfied now? I don't even get why you'd want to know more about me..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I'll have a new urban legend ready for the next time we meet."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right."

name: Shiori
message: "I know it's a bit late to say this after coming all the way here, but... we still haven't checked the urban legend from yesterday, have we?"

name: Shiori
message: "Asking her for a new rumor without checking out the previous one first would be... pretty shameless. We made a deal, so we need to follow through."

name: Shiori
message: "Before seeing Kashima Reiko-san, we should look into that urban legend about the mother with the stroller."

name: Shiori
message:

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... hold on for a bit."

name: Shiori
message: "I was just going with the flow, but... we haven't checked a single rumor she's told us about yet, have we?"

name: Shiori
message: "There's still the otherworldly manhole and the stroller rumor. We've yet to look into either of them."

name: Shiori
message: "We can't exactly ask her to tell us more without even checking out the ones she prepared for us. It'd feel... way too brazen."

name: Shiori
message: "I know I was the one who suggested the deal, but we should at least follow through... Actually, no."

name: Shiori
message: "We already know that I died in that park, so my body can't be there. In short, we don't need to check the otherworldly manhole anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "Which leaves the stroller, the one that might be connected to the little girl's ghost. Let's check it out first, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "We can see Kashima Reiko-san afterward."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Back again, I see."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we're here to hear about another urban legend."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I do have some prepared, but what kind of rumor do you want to hear?"

name: Shiori
message: "Before that."

name: Shiori
message: "Is there anything I can do for you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "What do you mean?"

name: Shiori
message: "Last time, all we did was ask, but we never did anything in return. That's why I was wondering if there was anything I could do."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I don't need it."

name: Shiori
message: "I still want to. It just feels wrong to keep taking without giving anything back."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then let's do this:"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll tell you unverified urban legends, ones whose authenticity I have yet to confirm."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And in return, you two will verify them and report back to me."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "How does that sound?"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, got it. We just need to go there, check it out, and report back, right?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Right, but I won't force you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They're unverified, in the sense that I don't know whether they're real, nor what dangers might await."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Who knows what threats lurk in the shadows? You could even die."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That's why whether you investigate or not is your choice to make."

name: Shiori
message: "I understand. Thanks for the warning."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Then our deal is settled. Now, let's get to business."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Back again, I see."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we're here to hear about another urban legend, but before that... we have to apologize."

name: Shiori
message: "About that manhole you told us last time... We haven't tried it yet."

name: Shiori
message: "The truth is... I found out where I died. It wasn't in another world, but at a park nearby."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Meaning your body can't be in the other world. Which means, there's no need to investigate it anymore. Is that right?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm really sorry. You explained it all so thoroughly, too."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You don't need to apologize. So, are your memories back?"

name: Shiori
message: "...No, not yet."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I see... That's too bad."

name: Shiori
message: "We're here today for something else. We're looking for the ghost of a little girl..."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe you've seen her? If not, then do you know any urban legends that involve little girls?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This girl... is she connected to your memories?"

name: Shiori
message: "All I can say is... probably. For some reason, she's been weighing on my mind."

name: Shiori
message: "Also, have you heard of the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case? We've been looking into that too."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you know anything about it?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I have no interest in the crimes of the living. And if that girl really is connected to the case... then I have nothing to offer."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "My knowledge won't be of any help to you."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... Thank you. And I'm sorry for always asking so many questions."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Don't worry about it. But you should stop coming here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This place is tainted. Neither the living nor the dead should draw near."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. I have nothing more to say."

name: Shiori
message: "...I understand. Thank you for everything. Goodbye."
"Thank you."
"Goodbye."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I hope you get your memories back."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, I should've expected as much. I ignored her info and even showed up again asking for more."

name: Shiori
message: "That was pretty shameless of me. I really should reflect on that. I got so caught up in my own problems that I wasn't thinking straight."

name: Shiori
message: "If anything ever bothers you, please tell me right away. I can be a bit dense sometimes."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, let's pull ourselves together and head somewhere else."

name: Shiori
message: "This should be the housing complex Kashima Reiko-san told us about."

name: Shiori
message: "I think this is where that ghost mother appears... the one pushing a stroller."

name: Shiori
message: "There weren't any specific conditions for her to appear. And we don't even know if she really shows up at all."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's look around a bit, and if we don't find anything, let's just tell Kashima Reiko-san that she wasn't here—"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh?"

name: Shiori
message: "There she is... That was surprisingly quick... but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...So you've come."

name: Shiori
message: "We checked the stroller urban legend you told us about yesterday. We're here to report."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "How was it?"

name: Shiori
message: "She... was there, but... she wasn't a ghost."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...She was a living person?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. And it wasn't an empty stroller either. There was a doll in it."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That's just plain horrifying..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I think so too... Maybe... maybe she's carrying some sort of trauma."

name: Shiori
message: "She clearly wasn't normal. In short, that urban legend..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Was based on her, made for laughs... Disgusting."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And I, who fell for that disgusting rumor... am just as revolting. My sins run deep."

name: Shiori
message: "I... don't think we should let this rumor spread. She'd be devastated if it reached her."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Of course. An urban legend without a supernatural core has no value."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I can't believe I gave you such a worthless lead. I've wronged you two."

name: Shiori
message: "No, I'm the one who's sorry. I insisted it had to involve children."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I must atone for this sin. Boil me, roast me, do whatever you see fit."

name: Shiori
message: "You don't have to take it that far..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If I leave it like this, it'll hurt my reputation. I will have my punishment."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm... In that case, can you tell us more urban legends?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ones involving children?"

name: Shiori
message: "No. Anything is fine, even if it's unrelated. We might stumble on an unexpected clue, after all. Just any rumor you're curious about."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...That's no punishment."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's not do that. For the sake of what comes next, let's keep things even between us. Okay?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Very well. If you insist..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please let us hear it."
